# Vital Athletic Recovery

> Vital Athletic Recovery (VAR) is a recovery and movement studio at 718 N. Buckner Blvd., Suite 416, Dallas, TX 75218 — in East Dallas, between Casa Linda and Casa View, about one mile east of White Rock Lake. We serve a five-mile radius covering Casa Linda, Casa View, Lakewood, Lake Highlands, Lochwood, Forest Hills, the M Streets, Lower Greenville, Old East Dallas, Junius Heights, Hollywood Heights, Munger Place, Buckner Terrace, and Mockingbird East. The studio combines science-backed recovery therapies — cold plunge, infrared sauna, traditional sauna, compression therapy, red light therapy (delivered inside our infrared saunas), and myofascial therapy — with Reformer classes and yoga, all under one membership.

**Location:** 718 N. Buckner Blvd., Suite 416, Dallas, TX 75218 (East Dallas, near Casa Linda)
**Phone:** (214) 308-2123
**Email:** owner@vitalathleticrecovery.com

## Services Offered

- **Cold Plunge** — Targeted cold-water immersion to reduce inflammation, sharpen focus, and prime the nervous system.
- **Infrared Sauna** — Deep cellular heat for detoxification, muscle recovery, and stress reduction.
- **Traditional Sauna** — Time-honored Finnish-style dry heat to open circulation, release stress, and finish recovery sessions.
- **Compression Therapy** — Pneumatic compression to flush lactic acid, restore circulation, and accelerate recovery.
- **Myofascial Therapy** — Soft-tissue release to unwind chronic tension, restore range of motion, and reset fascia.
- **Red Light Therapy** — Photobiomodulation that stimulates mitochondrial function, supporting skin, sleep, and recovery.
- **Reformer Classes** — Precision-led Reformer Pilates classes that build deep strength, control, and postural integrity.
- **Yoga & MindBody** — Restorative and flow practices for breath, mobility, and nervous-system regulation.

## Memberships

Prices are before tax. Essential and Vital are month-to-month with a 30-day cancellation notice. Unlimited requires a 3-month commitment. Vital and Unlimited can be frozen for up to 60 days per calendar year at no cost.

- **Essential** — $84.99/month. One full recovery session per week with access to every modality. Discounted Reformer & Yoga classes.
- **Vital** — $164.99/month. Unlimited recovery across every modality, one guest pass per month, discounted Reformer & Yoga classes, priority booking on classes.
- **Unlimited** — $349.99/month, 3-month commitment. Unlimited recovery, unlimited Reformer and Yoga classes, one guest pass every 7 days, priority booking on everything.

## Class Packs (no membership required)

- 8-Pack: $240
- 4-Pack: $140
- Single Class: $40
- Class packs work across both Yoga and Reformer. Members save 20%.
- Class minimum: classes run with 2 or more bookings. A class that has not reached 2 bookings two hours before start (or by 8 pm the night before for classes starting before 9 am) is cancelled; everyone booked is notified by text and email and the class credit is returned automatically.

## First-Visit Offer

Your First Recovery Visit Is 50% Off. Experience Vital Athletic Recovery for the first time with full access to our self-directed recovery space, including cold plunge, sauna, red light therapy, compression and recovery tools. First-time visitors only. Reformer Pilates, Yoga and private sessions are not included.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Do I have to commit to a long contract?**
Essential and Vital memberships are month-to-month with a 30-day cancellation notice. Unlimited requires a 3-month commitment.

**Is recovery safe if I'm new to cold plunge or sauna?**
Yes. Every first-time visit includes a brief walkthrough with a guide who tailors the experience to your body and goals. People who are pregnant, recovering from a recent injury, or who have a cardiovascular condition should consult their physician beforehand.

**What should I bring to my first visit?**
A swimsuit, workout clothes for Reformer or Yoga, and a water bottle. Towels are stocked in the wet and sauna area. We have 4 bathrooms; 2 with showers and 2 without. Recovery modalities are walk-in; only Reformer and Yoga classes require a booking.

**Do I need to sign a waiver before my first session?**
Yes. All first-time visitors sign a brief liability waiver at the front desk before any recovery session or class. It takes about two minutes. Returning members do not re-sign unless starting a new modality that requires its own acknowledgment.

**How do I arrive for my first visit?**
There are three paths: (1) pre-purchase a day pass or membership online and arrive any time during open hours; (2) walk in cold and buy a day pass or start a membership at the front desk; (3) book a Reformer or Yoga class online and arrive 5–10 minutes before class start. All three paths sign the waiver before participating in any session.

**What happens if a class doesn't have enough people booked?**
Classes run with 2 or more bookings. If a class hasn't reached 2 bookings two hours before start (or by 8 pm the night before for classes starting before 9 am), we cancel it and text and email everyone booked. Your class credit goes straight back to your account. Booking early is the best way to make sure your class runs.

**Can I freeze my membership?**
Yes. Vital and Unlimited memberships can be frozen for up to 60 days per calendar year at no cost. Contact us before your requested freeze date.

**Do you offer corporate or team memberships?**
Yes. The studio works with local teams, firms, and clinics on custom corporate wellness arrangements.

**How long is a typical session?**
Most members spend 45–75 minutes per visit. A focused circuit (cold + sauna + red light) takes about 45 minutes; a full reset (adding compression) takes around 75 minutes.
